lead: A Federal High Court in Gombe nullified the PDP primary that made former minister Isa Pantami the party's governorship candidate and ordered a new one. NECO released its 2026 results with a 58.67 per cent pass rate, and the NDLEA uncovered a methamphetamine lab in Enugu linked to a Mexican cartel. Atiku named Nasir El-Rufai to his campaign council, a group of lawmakers asked the National Assembly to reconvene over the President's absence, and the government cut the interest charged on late tax payments.

items.h: Court voids Pantami's ticket and orders fresh Gombe PDP primary
items.s: The Federal High Court in Gombe nullified the primary that produced former communications minister Isa Pantami as the PDP governorship candidate.

items.h: NECO records 58.67% pass rate in 2026 SSCE
items.s: 804,948 candidates obtained five credits including English and Mathematics in the internal examination.

items.h: NDLEA dismantles meth lab in Enugu linked to Mexican cartel
items.s: Officers uncovered a clandestine laboratory in Eziama, Obeagu, Awgu Local Government Area, and arrested suspected kingpins.

items.h: Atiku names El-Rufai to campaign council
items.s: The ADC candidate approved a lean campaign council and management team that includes the former Kaduna governor.

items.h: Lawmakers' group wants National Assembly to reconvene over Tinubu's absence
items.s: Serving federal lawmakers under the banner Save Democracy raised constitutional concerns about the President's continued stay abroad.

items.h: Late tax payments to attract MPR plus 1% from October
items.s: The government replaced the previous five-point spread with one point above the CBN policy rate for overdue naira taxes.

items.h: Petrol imports fall 26% as Dangote supplies 71%
items.s: NMDPRA data showed daily imports dropped to 14.6 million litres in August while NNPC refineries stayed shut.

items.h: EFCC explains why it declared Maina wanted
items.s: The commission said the former pension reform task force chief is sought over alleged receipt of stolen property.

items.h: Atiku says Tinubu must go in 2027
items.s: The ADC candidate blamed the APC for economic decline.

items.h: Wike says a strategy is being built to stop Atiku and Obi
items.s: The FCT minister said a new plan is underway to counter the two challengers.

items.h: Senator Kingibe challenges Wike over FCT loans
items.s: She asked the minister to produce Senate records showing approval for the FCT Administration's loans.

items.h: Ogun signs port agreement in Paris with Tinubu's backing
items.s: The President promised investors policy stability.

items.h: Umahi orders Tinubu's pictures on First Niger Bridge
items.s: The works minister gave the directive during an inspection of repairs.

items.h: Nigeria and Italy rally support for $5bn education fund
items.s: The two countries backed the Global Partnership for Education's financing campaign.

items.h: SEDC starts 200-hectare model farm in Enugu
items.s: The project is at Nomeh Unataeze, Nkanu East.

items.h: Tinubu welcomes $12m entrepreneurship centre
items.s: He said the Abuja centre will strengthen small businesses.

items.h: Boko Haram kills vigilante commander and four others in Borno
items.s: Terrorists attacked Wumbi in Kala-Balge and injured several civilians.

items.h: Three vigilantes killed and four miners die in Plateau
items.s: Gunmen ambushed vigilantes in Mangu, and a sand pit collapsed in Bokkos.

items.h: One shot as NSCDC and traders clash in Jos market
items.s: Vehicles were damaged at Chorbe Market, Jos North.

items.h: Benue doctor reported abducted later found in police custody
items.s: Family members had said Dr Jonah Ogbaji of Multicare Hospital, Makurdi, was taken by gunmen.

items.h: Kaduna police arrest arms dealers and foil kidnap
items.s: Officers recovered 300 rounds of ammunition and three locally made guns.

items.h: Amnesty alleges clampdown on Kano governor's critics
items.s: It reported arrests, detentions and threats against opposition supporters.

items.h: El-Rufai says he bears no resentment over allies' silence
items.s: The detained former governor addressed friends who have not supported him publicly.

items.h: CCB verifying assets of 20 ministers and 30 permanent secretaries
items.s: Chairman Abdullahi Bello disclosed the checks in Abuja.

items.h: ICPC reviews Rural Electrification Agency
items.s: The agency invited the review to strengthen accountability.

items.h: Ex-NBA chief says courts usurp voters' powers
items.s: Afam Osigwe warned about INEC's independence and weak electoral laws.

items.h: Lagos takes 34% of states' N5.15trn IGR
items.s: The state led all subnationals in 2025.

items.h: Inquiry into mining suspects' deaths begins sittings
items.s: The independent committee started hearings.

items.h: Moniepoint agents to sell Dangote refinery shares
items.s: Subscriptions will be available around the clock.

items.h: Kenya approves transfer of Access Bank Kenya to National Bank
items.s: The deal involves two Access subsidiaries.

items.h: Gambia orders banks to phase out foreign staff
items.s: Nigerian-owned banks are among those affected.

items.h: Solar mini-grid powers 13,000 residents in Kwara
items.s: A 581kWp grid was commissioned in Oke-Oyi, Ilorin East.

items.h: Brazil, Germany, India and Japan back permanent African UN seat
items.s: The G4 called for Security Council reform.

items.h: Joshua to fight Fury on 11 December
items.s: The British-Nigerian boxer confirmed the bout in the UK.

items.h: Super Eagles eye winning start against Madagascar
items.s: Coach Eric Chelle wants six points from the opening double-header.
